text:
# cm_rio_patch: CM's button outside the slot below, which opens only on a building of ours and so
							# hid CM's button for one not built yet (his screenshot 10-20, «Строительство сооружения «Арсенал»»).
							# Under CM the slot holds nothing visible and closes; CM's button takes its 20x44.
							cm_auto_expand_building_button_bll = { }

							widget = {
								visible = "[And3(Not(GetScriptedGui('glorpui_is_cm_active').IsShown(GuiScope.SetRoot(GetPlayer.MakeScope).End)), ObjectsEqual(LocationToBuildItem.GetBuilding.GetOwner, Player.Self), LocationToBuildItem.GetBuilding.GetType.IsMultipleLevels)]"
								size = { 20 44 } # GlorpUI: visible moved onto the checkbox
								datacontext = "[LocationToBuildItem.GetBuilding]"
why: CM's auto-expand button stood inside Río's slot gated on an existing building of ours, so a location without one had no CM button (his screenshot 10-20). It now stands beside the slot, which closes under CM.
